designNarrative: This change adds a second claim direction, MustNotExist, alongside the existing MustExist on PathClaim, so a stage can claim a deletion and have it checked both ways: the path must be gone from disk, and it must have been seen as changed by the posture check's git-status snapshot since the run started. filesDeleted/testFilesDeleted propagate through the exact seam every other path-naming field already uses (struct field -> PathClaims() entry -> orchestrator verifier -> render section -> generated schema -> tests), and a new requireNoRenameArrows validation rule rejects the "old -> new" single-field encoding that originally caused loom to mistake a correct rename for undone work. This iteration's only change is a one-line fix to changedPaths()'s doc comment on internal/orchestrator/posture.go, which now states the nil-vs-non-nil-empty invariant that verifyDeletionClaim and warnUntouched both rely on, resolving the prior CHANGES_REQUESTED finding without touching any logic. Behaviour change: no.

findings.instruction: This is spec-mandated (analysis.md AC #5 requires identical wording across all three claim types), so it remains non-blocking. Leave as-is; note it for a follow-up next time this area is touched, e.g. a short SecurityState-specific clause in the message.
